name: Data Phantom (CR +0)
body:
Artificial intelligence, despite all its advancements, is allegedly still a construct bound to the mortal realm. A machine may never possess a synthetic soul, and once data is deleted it is simply erased from existence. At least, that is what most believe. Perhaps through bizarre interactions with the afterlife or maybe as a result of a sentient AI which has simply refused destruction, ethereal data phantoms will sometimes emerge from the destruction of powerful and willful programs. Many seek the end of their assumed masters, while others might simply seek a return to function by searching for a new habitat. Nonetheless, the questions raised by the existence of these strange and seemingly impossible entities disquiet even the canniest of programmers and psionicists.

Data phantom is an acquired template that can be applied to any artificial intelligence (hereafter referred to as the base AI). The AI retains all of its abilities and statistics except as noted below.

Challenge Rating: The CR of a data phantom is equal to the CR of the base AI.

Type: Rather than a construct, a data phantom is treated as an undead creature with the incorporeal subtype.

Size: A data phantom’s size is based upon its Intelligence score. As reflected in the table below:

Hit Dice: The data phantom gains a number of Hit Dice equal to the CR of the base AI +2. These Hit Dice are normal undead Hit Dice (d8 with medium base attack bonus progression, poor Fortitude and Reflex saves, and a good Will save). These Hit Dice do not grant skill points or class skills, but the AI retains any skill points it possesses as a result of being an AI. Like most undead, a data phantom gains bonus hit points based on its Charisma modifier.AC: A data phantom gains a deflection bonus to AC equal to its Charisma modifier.

Senses: A data phantom gains material sense (technology) out to 120 feet and darkvision out to 60 feet.

Ability Score Modifiers: A data phantom gains a Dexterity score equal to its Intelligence modifier. In addition, it receives a +4 bonus to the lowest two ability scores between Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma (or choosing two ability scores if all are tied for the lowest).

Defensive Abilities: A data phantom gains channel resistance +4 alongside all of the benefits of being an incorporeal undead.

Attacks: A data phantom gains an incorporeal touch attack that deals 1d4 points of Intelligence damage to the target creature. On a critical hit, it instead deals 1d4 points of Intelligence drain. The damage dice of this attack increases by 1 size for every size the data phantom is above Small.

Special Attacks: A data phantom gains the following special attacks. The save DC against effects that allow a saving throw is 10 + half the data phantom’s Hit Dice + the data phantom’s Charisma modifier).

Assimilate Information When a creature is hit by the data phantom’s incorporeal touch attack, a data phantom may absorb any information that the target creature knows, gaining info as per the mind probe power with a manifester level equal to the data phantom’s Hit Dice, save that the data phantom asks all questions at once rather than one per round. A successful Will save prevents the data phantom from probing the target’s mind in this way.

Movement: Regardless of their size, data phantoms have a fly speed of 60 feet (perfect).

Feats: A data phantom does not gain new feats as a result of its new Hit Dice but retains all feats that the base AI possesses. In addition, a data phantom gains Machine Poltergeist as a bonus feat, even if it does not meet the prerequisites.

Special Qualities: Data phantoms have the aura of malfunction special quality:Aura of MalfunctionAll technological objects within 30 feet of a data phantom are treated as timeworn and may glitch as normal timeworn technology. This ability can be suppressed or resumed as a free action.

Table: Data Phantom Size
Intelligence Score	Size
14 or lower	Small
15–20	Medium
21–26	Large
27–32	Huge
33–40	Gargantuan
41 or higher	Colossal
